synthesis.problem_gist: Instrument-level MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY for CFD, CFD_FOREX, and CFD_STOCK (CRT-1891), maintained in dxMC, drives margin-liquidation order chunking per CRT-1785 when the cap is set. Defaults: CFD_FOREX_OTC=200, CFD_FOREX_DMA=20 000 000; plain CFD/CFD_STOCK have no default so chunking does not apply until configured. Jira E2E: oversized discretionary position allowed; at margin liquidation, 500 vs cap 200 produces three simultaneous child orders; completion waits for all; off-hours defers to session open; rejections follow CRT-1126 step 4 to in-review. Deliver on 270 branch.
